Procedure 2 exception. The bank confirms $17,040.00 of term loan and $11,625.00 of line interest accrued June 1 to 30, 2026, debited July 1. The debt schedule and account 2410 show $0.00: interest is recorded when paid. The report states the difference; it does not adjust the borrower’s figures. The FY2026 audit’s search for unrecorded liabilities proposes the same accrual.

Section 7.6 reads working capital from the statements “as shown … prepared under GAAP” and total liabilities as “shown on the balance sheet”. The office lease is disclosed (note 4, $1,484,173.90, $290,219.17 current) but not recognized. As shown: working capital $4,795,195.07, total liabilities $14,333,505.64, 2.05 to 1.00. With it: $4,504,975.90, $15,817,679.54, 2.26 to 1.00. Both comply; the bank decides which the agreement means.

Capital expenditures of $1,432,500.00 are $67,500.00 under the $1,500,000.00 limit, 4.5% of it. Not an exception; reported because the margin is narrow and the definition counts full cost however paid for.
No written representation from the borrower has been obtained for these procedures. It should cover the completeness of the debt, affiliate amounts and capital expenditures.
These are draft workpapers and findings for the engagement partner. They are not the agreed-upon procedures report and give no opinion or conclusion. Nothing has been signed or sent to the bank.
